title: Democratic Mechanisms: Double Majority Rules and Flexible Agenda Costs
title_zh: 民主机制：双重多数规则与灵活议程成本
official: 聚合元数据日期 2002-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop democratic mechanisms where individual utilities are not observable by other people at the legislative stage. We show that an appropriate combination of three rules can yield efficient provision of public projects: first, flexible and double majority rules where the size of the majority depends on the proposal and verifiable parameters and taxed and non-taxed individuals need to support the proposal; second, flexible agenda costs where the agenda-setter has to pay a certain amount of money if his proposal does not generate enough supporting votes; third, a ban on subsidies. We provide a rationale why double majority rules are used in practice. We also show that higher degrees of uncertainty about project parameters can make it easier to achieve first-best allocations and that universal equal treatment with regard to taxation is undesirable.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了立法阶段个体效用不可被他人观测的民主机制。研究表明，三项规则的恰当组合能够实现公共项目的有效供给：其一，灵活双重多数规则——多数规模取决于提案内容与可验证参数，且纳税人与非纳税人均需支持该提案；其二，灵活议程成本规则——若议程设定者的提案未获得足够支持票数，则需支付特定金额；其三，禁止补贴规则。本文为实践中采用双重多数规则提供了理论依据，同时证明项目参数不确定性程度的提高反而更易实现最优配置，并指出税收领域的普遍平等对待并不可取。

title: Can Cash Transfers Save Lives? Evidence from a Large-Scale Experiment in Kenya
title_zh: 现金转移能否拯救生命？来自肯尼亚大规模实验的证据
authors: Walker, Michael, Shankar, Nick, Miguel, Edward, Egger, Dennis, Killeen, Grady
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate the impacts of large-scale unconditional cash transfers on child survival. One-time transfers of USD 1000 were provided to over 10,500 poor households across 653 randomized villages in Kenya. We collected census data on over 100,000 births, including on mortality and cause of death, and detailed data on household health behaviors. Unconditional cash transfers (accounting for spillovers) lead to 48% fewer infant deaths before age one and 45% fewer child deaths before age five. Detailed data on cause of death, transfer timing relative to birth, and the location of health facilities indicate that unconditional cash transfers and access to delivery care are complements in generating mortality reductions: the largest gains are estimated in neonatal and maternal causes of death largely preventable by appropriate obstetric care and among households living close to physician-staffed facilities and those who receive the transfer around the time of birth, and treatment leads to a large increase in hospital deliveries (by 45%). The infant and child mortality declines are concentrated among poorer households with below median assets or predicted consumption. The transfers also result in a substantial decline of 51% in female labor supply in the three months before and the three months after a birth, and improved child nutrition. Infant and child mortality largely revert to pre-program levels after cash transfers end. Despite not being the main aim of the original program, we show that unconditional cash transfers in this setting may be a cost-effective way to reduce infant and child deaths.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了大规模无条件现金转移对儿童生存的影响。在肯尼亚653个随机村庄中，向超过10500户贫困家庭一次性发放了1000美元现金。我们收集了超过10万例出生人口的普查数据（包括死亡率与死因），以及家庭健康行为的详细数据。无条件现金转移（考虑溢出效应后）使一岁以下婴儿死亡率降低48%，五岁以下儿童死亡率降低45%。关于死因、转移支付时间与出生时间的关系以及医疗设施位置的详细数据表明，无条件现金转移与分娩护理的可及性在降低死亡率方面具有互补效应：最大收益体现在可通过适当产科护理预防的新生儿和孕产妇死因上，且集中在居住于配备医生设施附近、在分娩前后获得转移支付的家庭中；干预措施使医院分娩量大幅增加45%。婴儿和儿童死亡率的下降主要集中于资产或预测消费低于中位数的贫困家庭。转移支付还导致女性在分娩前后各三个月的劳动供给大幅下降51%，并改善了儿童营养状况。现金转移结束后，婴儿和儿童死亡率基本恢复至项目前水平。尽管并非原始项目的主要目标，我们证明在此情境下，无条件现金转移可能是降低婴儿和儿童死亡率的成本有效方式。

title: Public Debt Levels and Real Interest Rates: Causal Evidence from Parliamentary Elections
title_zh: 公共债务水平与实际利率：来自议会选举的因果证据
authors: Ehrlich, Gabriel, Kay, Owen, Thapar, Aditi
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We use close parliamentary elections as natural experiments to estimate the debt sensitivity of interest rates. Relative to an election in which one party barely secures a majority, an election in which no party achieves a majority causes the debt-to-GDP ratio to increase by 17 percentage points, while real interest rates rise by 99 basis points. If elections only impact real rates via debt, our results imply that a one percentage point increase in the debt-to-GDP ratio causes a 5.8 basis point increase in real rates, larger than most previous estimates.
abstract_zh: 我们以议会选举结果接近的选举作为自然实验，估算利率对债务的敏感度。与某一政党勉强获得多数席位的选举相比，无政党获得多数席位的选举会导致债务与GDP之比上升17个百分点，同时实际利率上升99个基点。若选举仅通过债务影响实际利率，我们的结果表明，债务与GDP之比每上升1个百分点，实际利率将上升5.8个基点，这一数值高于以往多数估计结果。

title: The Missing Middle Managers: Labor Costs, Firm Structure, and Development
title_zh: 缺失的中层管理者：劳动力成本、企业结构与发展
authors: Hjort, Jonas, Malmberg, Hannes, Schoellman, Todd
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using data obtained from human resources consulting firms, we document the cost to large firms of hiring managers and business professionals in 146 countries worldwide. The average pay in the poorest decile of countries is $18,000 per year, which is 9.7 times GDP per worker. In contrast, in the richest decile of countries, large firms pay managers and business professionals only 0.8 times GDP per worker. We use an appropriate technology model to show that the cost of management could be an important deterrent to the expansion of the modern sector in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 利用从人力资源咨询公司获取的数据，我们记录了全球146个国家大型企业招聘管理人员和商务专业人士的成本。在收入最低的十分位国家中，平均年薪为18,000美元，是人均GDP的9.7倍。相比之下，在收入最高的十分位国家中，大型企业支付给管理人员和商务专业人士的薪酬仅为人均GDP的0.8倍。我们采用适宜技术模型表明，管理成本可能是阻碍发展中国家现代部门扩张的重要因素。

title: Estimating Nursing Home Quality with Selection
title_zh: 基于选择效应的养老院质量评估
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We use variational inference (VI), a technique from the machine learning literature, to estimate a mortality-based Bayesian model of nursing home quality accounting for selection. We demonstrate how one can use VI to quickly and flexibly estimate a high-dimensional economic model with large datasets. Using our facility quality estimates, we examine the correlates of quality and find that public report cards have near-zero correlation. We then show that in contrast to prior literature, higher-quality nursing homes fared better during the pandemic: a one standard deviation increase in quality corresponds to 2.5% fewer COVID-19 cases.
abstract_zh: 我们采用变分推断（VI）这一机器学习领域的技术，对考虑选择效应的养老院质量死亡率贝叶斯模型进行估计。我们展示了如何利用VI快速且灵活地估计基于大数据集的高维经济模型。基于设施质量估计结果，我们考察了质量的相关因素，发现公开报告卡与质量之间的相关性近乎为零。进一步研究表明，与既往文献结论相反，高质量养老院在疫情期间表现更优：质量每提高一个标准差，新冠肺炎病例数减少2.5%。

title: Greening drylands: The potential and limits of afforestation as a nature-based solution in the Aralkum Desert
title_zh: 绿化干旱区：咸海沙漠中基于自然的造林方案的潜力与局限
authors: Shahzoda Alikhanova, Alison Smith, Cristina Tarantino, Joseph William Bull
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Dryland afforestation is increasingly deployed as a Nature-based Solution (NbS) for climate mitigation and ecosystem restoration, yet its long-term effectiveness remains uncertain because carbon gains may be offset by biophysical trade-offs and water limitations. Existing assessments rarely integrate carbon sequestration, surface albedo, and climate vulnerability, limiting understanding of how these processes interact to determine restoration outcomes. Here we present the first integrated assessment of large-scale afforestation in the South Aral Sea – a region whose near-complete desiccation may have shifted the area from a carbon sink toward a source of emissions. We evaluate the current carbon pool, surface albedo effects, and climate vulnerability to assess both the potential and inherent limits of dryland afforestation as an NbS. By combining field surveys of saxaul (Haloxylon) shrublands, analysis of land cover change, and six decades of regional climate data, we estimate that the vegetated parts of the South Aral Sea (approximately 1.6 million hectares) store 20.4 million tonnes of carbon (74.7 million tonnes CO₂-equivalent) in soil and vegetation, with a mean carbon density of 12.7 Mg C ha⁻¹ . Albedo analysis reveals strongly context-dependent climate trade-offs: vegetation establishment increases surface reflectivity on former water bodies but decreases it on highly reflective salt pans. Over the past six decades, regional temperatures have increased by approximately 0.5°C per decade (more than twice the global average) while drought intensity has increased markedly since the 1990s. Temperature-adjusted drought indices (SPEI-12) indicate substantially stronger drying trends (R² = 0.55) than precipitation-only indices (SPI-12; R² = 0.03), demonstrating that rising temperatures amplify water stress beyond precipitation changes alone and may constrain the vegetation density that can be sustained over time. Our findings show that afforestation can contribute meaningfully to carbon storage and landscape stabilisation in severely degraded drylands, but its long-term viability as an NbS depends on adaptive management that respects water-limited carrying capacity, incorporates drought-resilient species, and optimises planting density. The integrated framework presented here offers empirical guidance for designing climate-resilient NbS in drylands worldwide, where nearly one-fifth of Earth's land surface faces accelerating degradation by the end of this century.
abstract_zh: 旱地造林作为基于自然的解决方案（NbS）在气候缓解和生态系统恢复中的应用日益广泛，但其长期有效性仍不确定，因为碳收益可能被生物物理权衡和水资源限制所抵消。现有评估很少整合碳固存、地表反照率和气候脆弱性，限制了对这些过程如何相互作用以决定恢复结果的理解。本研究首次对南咸海地区大规模造林进行综合评估——该地区近乎完全干涸可能已使其从碳汇转变为碳排放源。我们评估了当前碳库、地表反照率效应和气候脆弱性，以探究旱地造林作为NbS的潜力与固有局限。通过结合梭梭灌木林实地调查、土地覆被变化分析及六十年区域气候数据，我们估算南咸海植被覆盖区域（约160万公顷）在土壤和植被中储存了2040万吨碳（7470万吨二氧化碳当量），平均碳密度为12.7 Mg C ha⁻¹。反照率分析揭示了强烈依赖情境的气候权衡：植被建立增加了原水体区域的地表反射率，但降低了高反射盐滩的反射率。过去六十年间，区域气温以每十年约0.5°C的速度上升（超过全球平均水平两倍），而自1990年代以来干旱强度显著加剧。经温度调整的干旱指数（SPEI-12）显示比仅基于降水的指数（SPI-12；R²=0.03）更强的干燥趋势（R²=0.55），表明升温加剧了超出降水变化本身的水分胁迫，并可能限制可持续维持的植被密度。研究结果表明，造林可为严重退化旱地的碳储存和景观稳定做出实质性贡献，但其作为NbS的长期可行性取决于尊重水资源承载能力、采用耐旱物种并优化种植密度的适应性管理。本研究所提出的综合框架为全球旱地设计气候适应性NbS提供了经验指导——到本世纪末，全球近五分之一陆地表面正面临加速退化。

title: Wagering the Bread Money: Sports Betting Legalization and Food Sufficiency
title_zh: 赌上面包钱：体育博彩合法化与食物充足性
authors: Xiaohui Guo, Lizhong Peng, Chad Meyerhoefer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This is the first study to estimate the impact of sports gambling legalization on food sufficiency using the staggered implementation of state laws between 2021-2023. By analyzing Google searches for online sportsbooks and legal wagers, we show that interest in sports gambling increases sharply following legalization. Applying an imputation-based difference-in-differences design to biweekly Household Pulse Survey (HPS) data, we find that legalized sports gambling reduces household food sufficiency by 2.1 percent among working-age adults without a college degree, which translates to a 10.5 percent decline among active bettors. This effect is cyclical, persisting for three-to-five months during NFL seasons. Additionally, the declines in food sufficiency are larger among households with adults aged 25-44 and racial/ethnic minorities. Using additional data from the HPS, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and Current Population Survey, our exploration of mechanisms suggests that the negative effects on food sufficiency operate through financial distress rather than changes in mental health or labor supply. A back-of-the-envelope calculation indicates that legalization of sports gambling in nine states resulted in an additional 284, 000 food-insufficient households and $130.2 million in excess healthcare expenditures annually.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用2021至2023年间各州法律分阶段实施的情况，评估体育博彩合法化对食品充足性的影响。通过分析在线体育博彩平台的谷歌搜索量及合法投注数据，我们发现合法化后公众对体育博彩的兴趣急剧上升。采用基于插补的双重差分法对双周家庭脉搏调查（HPS）数据进行分析，结果显示，体育博彩合法化使未获得大学学位的劳动年龄人口家庭食品充足性下降2.1%，相当于活跃投注者群体中该指标下降10.5%。这一效应呈现周期性特征，在NFL赛季期间持续三至五个月。此外，在25-44岁成年人家庭及少数族裔群体中，食品充足性下降幅度更为显著。通过整合HPS、行为风险因素监测系统及当前人口调查的补充数据，我们对作用机制的探索表明，食品充足性受到的负面影响主要通过财务困境传导，而非心理健康或劳动力供给的变化。粗略估算显示，九个州的体育博彩合法化每年导致新增28.4万个食品不足家庭，并产生1.302亿美元的额外医疗支出。

title: US Monetary Policy, Exchange Rates, and Delayed Portfolio Adjustments
title_zh: 美国货币政策、汇率与延迟的投资组合调整
authors: Sangyup Choi, Jongho Park, Kwangyong Park
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: What accounts for cross-country heterogeneity in exchange-rate responses to U.S. monetary policy shocks? Using daily data around Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements for 34 countries from 2001 to 2019, we show that countries with deeper financial markets experience larger currency depreciations following contractionary U.S. monetary policy shocks. This amplification is concentrated in forward-guidance shocks rather than contemporaneous target-rate surprises. The result is robust to alternative measures of financial market depth and to controls for domestic monetary policy responses, broad dollar movements, and various country characteristics. The amplification fades within approximately one month, suggesting that financial market depth matters primarily for high-frequency exchange-rate adjustment. A parsimonious portfolio-adjustment model interprets these empirical patterns by linking market depth to lower rebalancing costs and by treating forward guidance as news about future interest-rate differentials.
abstract_zh: 什么因素导致了各国汇率对美国货币政策冲击的异质性反应？利用2001年至2019年34个国家在联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后的日度数据，我们发现，金融市场深度较大的国家在遭遇紧缩性美国货币政策冲击时，会经历更大幅度的货币贬值。这种放大效应集中于前瞻性指引冲击，而非同期目标利率意外变化。该结果在采用替代性金融市场深度指标、控制国内货币政策反应、广义美元走势以及多种国家特征后依然稳健。放大效应约在一个月内消退，表明金融市场深度主要影响高频汇率调整。一个简约的投资组合调整模型通过将市场深度与较低的投资组合再平衡成本相联系，并将前瞻性指引视为关于未来利差的信息，对这些实证模式进行了解释。

title: A Temporary VAT Cut as Unconventional Fiscal Policy
title_zh: 临时性增值税减免作为非常规财政政策
authors: Rüdiger Bachmann, Benjamin Born, Olga Goldfayn-Frank, Georgi Kocharkov, Ralph Luetticke 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We exploit Germany’s temporary three-percentage-point VAT cut in the second half of 2020 to study the spending response to unconventional fiscal policy. We use survey and scanner data on household consumption expenditures and their perceived pass-through of the tax change into prices, and a HANK model to quantify the effects of this VAT policy. The survey and scanner data show that the temporary VAT reduction led to a relative increase in durable and, to a lesser extent, semi-durable spending for individuals with high perceived pass-through. According to the HANK model, the VAT policy increased total aggregate consumption spending by 4.4 percent on impact.
abstract_zh: 本文利用德国2020年下半年临时性下调增值税三个百分点的政策，研究非传统财政政策对消费支出的影响。我们采用家庭消费支出的调查与扫描数据，以及消费者对税改价格传导的感知程度，并借助HANK模型量化该增值税政策的效果。调查与扫描数据显示，对于感知传导程度较高的群体，临时性增值税下调显著提升了耐用品支出，半耐用品支出也有较小幅度的增长。根据HANK模型测算，该增值税政策在实施初期使总消费支出增加了4.4%。
